# Ictus Flow Ltd
## AI Consultancy for Construction

> Ictus Flow builds AI-powered tools for the UK construction industry, exclusively on Claude by Anthropic.

## Products

### PreconAI
Upload a tender document. Get a full preconstruction team analysis in minutes. Six AI agents — Director, Senior Estimator, Junior Estimator, Procurement, Administrator, Bid Writer.
URL: https://preconai.ictusflow.com

### SVL (Site Voice Logger)
Voice-first site diary for construction. Speak your daily report on the walk-round, get a formal site diary, action list, and progress summary.

### Document Automation
Automated invoice processing, correspondence drafting, and compliance tracking for SMEs and charities. Drop documents into Google Drive, AI handles the rest.

### Blocker Management App
Multi-company blocker tracking for construction projects. Field workers report, managers assign, subcontractors resolve. Full audit trail.

### VividFlow
Automated lead generation for UK trades businesses. Targeted prospect lists, automated email sequences, AI-powered replies.

## About
